scope: Public policy, Android/AOSP source, bounded static analysis of Tencent-distributed Xiaohongshu 9.50.0, local android-use implementation and prior observer samples. APK never installed or executed.
conclusion: The 9.50.0 APK includes concrete getters for accessibility status and enabled-service identifiers, plus ADB-state reads inside its Getui SDK. android-use exposes a service identifier and Android accessibility input signals. Runtime invocation, telemetry use, bot classification and account enforcement remain unverified.

xiaohongshu.product: Xiaohongshu mainland-user policy; rednote users have a separate policy
xiaohongshu.actual_current_apk_detection: Static detection/data-reading capability observed in Tencent 9.50.0; actual live detection and enforcement unknown.

findings.evidence_type: AOSP source and prior local observer
findings.observed: Android 15/16 initial release Settings.java marks ADB_ENABLED and DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED readable. Newer AOSP adds redacted value 0. SettingsProvider applies it through a platform flag for application UIDs; it is not a universal targetSdk rule.
findings.ours: Prior Samsung Android 16 observer recorded both settings 0, adbd stopped, USB mtp, control ports closed and runner jar absent.
findings.limitation: Firmware backports and flags vary. A redacted 0 alone does not establish that debugging is off.

findings.evidence_type: Public Android API and prior local observer
findings.observed: getEnabledAccessibilityServiceList exposes enabled service information. Current AOSP installed-service enumeration has package visibility filtering; enabled-service enumeration follows a different code path.
findings.ours: com.androiduse.phone/.PocketService was visible to the ordinary observer.
findings.limitation: An enabled accessibility service alone does not establish harmful automation. User/profile/UiAutomation state can affect results.

findings.evidence_type: Android 16 AOSP source plus current own implementation; not live MotionEvent capture on Samsung
findings.observed: MotionEventInjector labels injected accessibility input; InputDispatcher maps it to FLAG_IS_ACCESSIBILITY_EVENT. MotionEvent.java documents the event flag value as 0x800, while getFlags is public.
findings.ours: PocketService uses dispatchGesture, so the framework path has an observable accessibility-origin signal. Rust and TLS do not remove the Android input path.
findings.limitation: Not proof that Xiaohongshu reads this flag or that all vendors deliver identical event fields. It identifies accessibility origin, not necessarily a bot.

findings.evidence_type: AOSP source, current own implementation, prior synthetic observer
findings.observed: AccessibilityInteractionController invokes target View.performAccessibilityAction or AccessibilityNodeProvider.performAction. TextView handles ACTION_SET_TEXT by setting the text. A target custom view/delegate can observe the action.
findings.ours: PocketService typeText performs ACTION_SET_TEXT; this does not look identical to keyboard InputConnection commits.
findings.limitation: TextWatcher changes alone do not uniquely identify automation; Xiaohongshu actual view/SDK handlers were not examined.

findings.observed: The policy declares collection of software-use and running-state data for risk verification.
findings.inference: Activity patterns and account/network/device context could provide a separate classification channel even when debugging signals are absent.
findings.limitation: Feature lists, thresholds, active SDK calls and enforcement are not public evidence here.

apk_analysis.source: Official Xiaohongshu download page points to Tencent distribution; https://a.app.qq.com/o/simple.jsp?pkgname=com.xingin.xhs supplied the 9.50.0 APK URL.
apk_analysis.apk_signature_verification: apksigner verify succeeded; not independently compared to a previously trusted publisher fingerprint
apk_analysis.engine: Existing local JADX CLI 1.5.6 with JDK 21; plain CLI evidence, not REA Android Evidence
decompilation_scope: classes16.dex in simple mode (14 reported decompilation errors)
string tables of all 22 DEX members and native-library string/export inventory

observed_call_paths.result: Can read enabled service identifiers in the default static implementation; no claim of live invocation.
Concrete setting read with static callers; located in Getui SDK, not proof of a first-party Xiaohongshu enforcement rule.
Detection entry and delegate present; full detector and live behavior not analyzed.

native_candidates.limitation: JNI test exports and strings alone do not establish production execution.

apk_analysis.rea_status: Android provider lacked configured JADX MCP JAR. Native Hopper launcher was denied macOS Apple Events; REA reported cleanup_incomplete and retained /tmp/rea-Hg9rKU. No native pseudocode was obtained and no permissions were changed.
limitations: A155 had no installed com.xingin.xhs package. This sample is not a device-exported current installation.
No app/account operation or runtime hook performed.
Robust PatchProxy can replace default getter behavior; native, dynamic configuration and server policy were not fully analyzed.
Whole-APK decompilation exceeded 1.5 GiB heap; focused DEX/class results were used instead.
Negative string searches do not exclude encrypted, concatenated, native or hot-patched checks.
apk_analysis.settings_reader_default_path: The secure-settings wrapper special-cases android_id; enabled_accessibility_services takes its default Settings.Secure.getString path.

verification_needed: Observe authorized runtime calls and telemetry for an exact installed version; static presence alone does not establish execution.
Capture accessibility-origin flags in the synthetic observer on Samsung firmware.
Evaluate server behavior only through permitted tests; no enforcement thresholds are established here.
marketing_claim: Runtime control without ADB and measured reduction of debugging signals. Do not claim undetectable automation or that Xiaohongshu accepts it.
